close_reason: Added stable + beta matrix to test job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Beta is advisory (continue-on-error: true on matrix.rust == 'beta'), fail-fast: false so beta failures don't cancel stable. Updated header docstring and removed beta TODO marker. Also updated MSRV TODO to reference JMAP-ulfy blocker.
description:
Plan C deferred from JMAP-sc1b.9. The current .github/workflows/ci.yml runs fmt / clippy / test / doc / typos only on stable. Add a parallel matrix leg on the beta Rust toolchain to catch incoming-Rust regressions early. Beta failures are warnings (continue-on-error) — they should not block merges, but they surface impending breakage so we can adjust before stable picks up the change.

Implementation hint: copy the test job, add 'rust: [stable, beta]' matrix and 'continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.rust == 'beta' }}'. Use dtolnay/rust-toolchain@${{ matrix.rust }}.

Closes the beta TODO comment in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
title: CI: add beta toolchain matrix leg
